dialogues.speaker: Nacker
dialogues.text: ...It's you. Come to see the pathetic loser, have you?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Are you enjoying your stay?

dialogues.speaker: Nacker
dialogues.text: Of course. Here, I don't have to ponder over complex technical issues or constantly be forced to recall each and every step of painfully precise operations.

dialogues.speaker: Nacker
dialogues.text: More importantly, I don't have to deal with those short-sighted, arrogant fools.

dialogues.speaker: Nacker
dialogues.text: Based on those few facets alone, the Fortress of Meropide is vastly preferable to the Fontaine Research Institute.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: ...Bye.

dialogues.speaker: Nacker
dialogues.text: Leave. You've already won. Don't come back.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You fooled everyone in the Central Laboratory.

dialogues.speaker: Nacker
dialogues.text: Yes, and I have to thank you once again. Without your cooperation, which you gave freely, I would have never figured out how to discreetly send that reporter lady packing.

dialogues.speaker: Nacker
dialogues.text: Still, I underestimated Raimondo's perspicacity. I never expected him to be able to uncover the truth, least of all in a situation like that.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What did Concini promise you?

dialogues.speaker: Nacker
dialogues.text: I don't give a hoot about his promises. I just don't want the Institute to terminate the Arkhium research project.

dialogues.speaker: Nacker
dialogues.text: Countless people put their hearts and souls into it, myself included. It's just a step away from fruition!

dialogues.speaker: Nacker
dialogues.text: If they pull the plug now, all of our magnificent research will have been for nothing!

dialogues.speaker: Nacker
dialogues.text: Raimondo, that fool, he's far too conservative! All he cares about is securing his own career. He couldn't care less about the state of the Institute.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: And you're just looking out for your own interests.

dialogues.speaker: Nacker
dialogues.text: It's my research too! Do you have any idea how much effort I put into helping create the Arkhium Kinetic Core? Why can't I look out for my own interests, like the rest of you?

dialogues.speaker: Nacker
dialogues.text: Am I supposed to meekly submit to Choiseul's will and give up on Arkhium, just like that?

dialogues.speaker: Nacker
dialogues.text: All just to focus on mind-numbingly tedious contraptions like Mekafish, Fonta, and the like? I'd rather die!

dialogues.speaker: Nacker
dialogues.text: Talking about this now is an exercise in futility, anyway. I no longer have any ties to the Fontaine Research Institute.

dialogues.speaker: Nacker
dialogues.text: Arkhium, the Arkhium Kinetic Core, the future Fontaine Research Institute... Whatever. Let it all be.

dialogues.speaker: Nacker
dialogues.text: My research days are over.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Are you enjoying your stay?

dialogues.speaker: Nacker
dialogues.text: Of course. Here, I don't have to ponder over complex technical issues or constantly be forced to recall each and every step of painfully precise operations.

dialogues.speaker: Nacker
dialogues.text: More importantly, I don't have to deal with those short-sighted, arrogant fools.

dialogues.speaker: Nacker
dialogues.text: Based on those few facets alone, the Fortress of Meropide is vastly preferable to the Fontaine Research Institute.

dialogues.speaker: Nacker
dialogues.text: Oh, and I noticed that Jurieu fellow managed to build the Wingalet. He does seem to have some talent.

dialogues.speaker: Nacker
dialogues.text: Mr. Edwin's assistant has completed a significant undertaking, while Edwin himself remains where he started, empty-handed and frustrated.

dialogues.speaker: Nacker
dialogues.text: Hahahahaha! Serves you right, Edwin!
